From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: success signals, acceptance tests & cutover flow

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As promised, I attached a draft mutual action plan (Integris_MAP_v0.3.xlsx) and a companion acceptance test catalog (acceptance_test_catalog.csv). This thread is to lock the success criteria and exit gates so we can schedule the pilot cutover and finalize procurement terms.

High-level asks:
- Please confirm owners for each acceptance test (column "Owner" in the spreadsheet)
- Confirm the two priority evaluation scenarios: clinical note extraction (latency/concordance) and EMR routing accuracy
- Agree on go/no-go date range: target cutover window 2025-10-01 to 2025-10-07

Key MAP excerpts in this draft:
- Success signals: 95%+ label concordance on clinical extraction (sample size = 1,000 docs), median inference latency <= 180 ms at 95th pct tail, no PII leakage in top-10 outputs
- Exit gates (fail-fast): concordance < 92% on validated set OR sustained latency spikes > 300 ms over a 1 hour window OR any uncovered data residency non-compliance
- Acceptance tests: smoke, regression (50 scenarios), load test (20 TPS sustained), security questionnaire evidence (SOC2 scope items)

Attachments: Integris_MAP_v0.3.xlsx (MAP + decision ledger), acceptance_test_catalog.csv (detailed test cases), SLA_proposal.pdf (SLA draft)

Next steps: please review and reply with owners/edits by EOD Friday (2025-08-22). If agreeable, propose a 30-min sign-off on Mon 2025-08-25.

Thanks — I put Marissa on copy to capture the test owners and timeline.

— Karthik

Karthik — thanks for the draft. A few clarifying Qs before we assign owners:

1) For the concordance metric: what is the exact gold-labeling protocol you used to estimate the 95% figure (sample selection, annotator guidelines, adjudication)? We need that for our QA team.
2) Data residency: Integris requires that PHI processing remain in the us-east-1 region. Does the MAP assume regional pinning or will routing be done at request-level?
3) For load: 20 TPS sustained seems reasonable but how do you account for burst behavior during shift changes? We need a failover plan.

Procurement on CC — can you confirm the procurement checklist and any required contract language for data handling?

Also, can you provide example prompt/test snippets you plan to run for the 50 regression scenarios? That'll help our clinicians validate.

Thanks,

Sara — great questions. Quick answers and proposed updates to the MAP (I will update Integris_MAP_v0.3 and return v0.4):

1) Concordance gold-labeling protocol (short):
- Sampling: stratified by facility (top 6 hospitals), clinical domain (notes, discharge summaries, consults) — target N=1,000
- Annotation: two independent clinicians + adjudicator for disagreements > 5%
- Acceptance threshold: 95% aggregated concordance, per-domain floor 92%

2) Data residency: Redwood can pin inference to us-east-1 for Integris. MAP will include a routing policy: all PHI processing flows to pinned region; fallback endpoints will be disabled. Add to decision ledger under "infra constraints".

3) Burst handling: recommend two-tier smoothing: auto-burst pool (short-lived capacity) + request-priority queueing. Acceptance tests will include a 10-minute burst at 80 TPS to validate graceful degradation and fallback to queued processing. Rollback trigger: persistent > 300 ms median latency for 15 minutes.

4) Regression snippets: attaching a short CSV with 12 representative prompts and expected normalized outputs; we'll expand to 50 in the next revision. Clinicians can use that as the seed set for validation.

Proposed exit gates (concise):
- Safety/PII: any confirmed PII exfiltration event => immediate suspend
- Model quality: aggregated concordance < 92% across core sample => pause cutover
- Ops: any unmitigated region failover exceeding 5 minutes without auto-failover => rollback

I'll make the decision ledger explicit: columns = Test ID, Owner, Success metric, Measurement method, Pass threshold, Risk owner, Rollback trigger, Evidence link. That will make handoffs clear.

If that aligns, Karthik — can you confirm we have legal/procurement language for region pinning and SOC2 evidence?

— Marissa

Please review the updated decision ledger (sheet: DecisionLedger) and reply with owner assignments for each Test ID by COB Monday 2025-08-25. If owners are confirmed, I'll schedule the 30-min sign-off and circulate the final doc for signatures (DocuSign link to follow).

Proposed acceptance gating snapshot (short):
- Essential pass: concordance >= 95% (aggregate) AND median latency <= 180 ms at 95th pct
- Soft pass: concordance 92-95% with mitigations and extended validation window
- Fail -> rollback: concordance < 92% OR unapproved data-residency violation OR security gap in SOC2 evidence

Attachments: Integris_MAP_v0.4.xlsx (updated), acceptance_test_catalog.csv (seed tests), SLA_proposal.pdf

If these look good, Marissa will be the internal owner to run the verification and I will coordinate procurement.

Thanks — Karthik
